messages:
Emily Latham: Heads-up — we need to push a hotfix to staging now, it's blocking the async-queue OOM seen in canary. Requesting expedited approvals for a staged cutover + an AB cohort pin so experiment traffic doesn't get skewed.

Raj Patel: What's the rollout plan? Can we do a narrow 5% AB cohort in staging first? Also need a short release-note blurb I can put in the PR.

Emily Latham: Plan: deploy tag hotfix-20260321-1 to staging canary (5%), hold 10m, expand to 30% then full staging. If stable, promote to prod-canary. We'll pin experiment cohort 'exp_q2' to control at 20% traffic during the rollout so bucket drift is controlled.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks running...

deploy-bot: PRELIGHT OK — image: gcr.io/redwood/hotfix:hotfix-20260321-1
services: async-queue, router
smoke: passed
kvcache: warm

Sara Kim: I can approve for infra — latency & memory look fine on the staging cluster when I ran the smoke locally. :thumbsup:

Derek O'Neill: Oncall here — I approve with a rollback window of 30m. If error rate > 0.5% or p99 latency doubles, revert to hotfix-rollback-20260321. I need a Prometheus alert configured: alertname=HotfixErrorRate.

Kate Morris: PM — note for release notes: fixes streaming OOM when processing long prompts; affected region: EU (some customers). Keep me posted on customer-impacting changes.

Raj Patel: Release-note blurb suggestion: "Fix async-queue OOM when processing long-context streaming requests. Improves stability for long-running prompt flows; no model changes." OK for me.

Emily Latham: Yep that's the blurb. Kicking off now: /deploy start staging hotfix-20260321-1 abtest_pin=exp_q2:control=20% wait=10m

deploy-bot: Deploy started by Emily Latham

deploy-bot: Step 1/4 — pushing image
OK
Step 2/4 — canary 5% applied
OK
Step 3/4 — smoke tests
OK
Step 4/4 — post-smoke hold 10m

Sara Kim: Monitoring dashboards, will surface any regressions during the hold.

(10m later)

Sara Kim: Hold complete, no regressions observed across async-queue and router. :white_check_mark:

Emily Latham: Moving to 30% expansion. /deploy expand staging hotfix-20260321-1 to=30%

deploy-bot: Expansion started

Derek O'Neill: Alert hooks are in place; if anything spikes I will cut and start rollback procedure.

Raj Patel: Approved for prod promotion after a 30% hold and validation.

deploy-bot: Promotion to prod-canary scheduled by Emily Latham. Tag pinned. deploy-id: 20260321-ef12

Emily Latham: Thanks all. I'll open the release notes PR with Raj's blurb and tag docs + PM. I'll also note the rollback command in the PR: 

Rollback command: 

```
/deploy rollback staging hotfix-20260321-1 --reason="OOM regression"
```

Kate Morris: Thanks — please add a short migration/impact note for EU customers in the PR.

Sara Kim: :party_parrot: All clear from infra on staging. Will watch prod-canary once promoted.
